summary: Verified reported 'login gagal' symptom. All auth flows work correctly. Backend: admin login returns 200 with cookie+JWT+admin role; wrong password returns 401 with exact message 'Email atau password salah'; GET /api/users returns 14 users including admin. Frontend: /masuk login with admin@fh.unri.ac.id/admin123 redirected to /dasbor/admin with welcome toast. No code/data bug — likely user typo (case-sensitive email or caps-lock on password).
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin@fh.unri.ac.id/admin123 -> 200, user.role=admin, JWT + cookie set
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401 with detail 'Email atau password salah'
GET /api/users (admin cookie) -> 200, 14 users incl. admin@fh.unri.ac.id, kalab@fh.unri.ac.id, tu@fh.unri.ac.id
MongoDB users collection is not empty (14 users)
Frontend /masuk login -> redirect to /dasbor/admin (Panel Admin visible, welcome toast shown)
action_items: Confirm to user: admin@fh.unri.ac.id / admin123 works end-to-end. Ask them to check caps-lock, email case (must be lowercase), or whether they were trying a self-created account. Suggest admin can reset staff passwords via Panel Admin > Pengguna.
